messages:
taylor: Quick ping from today's all-hands finance segment  folks asked for a short primer on hiring-pause criteria, vendor terms, and emergency infra buys. Can we summarize?

maria: TL;DR: runway target = ~18 months. Hiring slowdowns triggered by sustained burn or revenue misses: specifically >10% burn variance OR bookings shortfall >15% for 30 days. When triggered we do targeted slowdowns, not a blanket freeze.

vp_ops: To add: managers should expect careful prioritization and a requirement to justify each role. Critical hires can be escalated for exception by VP + Finance.

sam: For contractors & renewals, what's the authority matrix? We have a backend contractor with renewal in 5 weeks.

maria: Contractors: manager + finance for renewals under $50k/yr. Anything >= $50k/yr needs VP sign-off and procurement review for alternatives. Try to provide a short business case (1-2 bullets) when submitting.

hr_zoe: Guidance for open reqs in Greenhouse during a slowdown? Close or keep?

vp_ops: Keep open but mark as "on hold". Add a note with expected review date and reason. Recruiters will keep the pipeline warm and won't schedule new interviews until cleared.

cto_lee: Infra note: emergency/production-impact purchases can use the expedited procurement flow for short-term capacity (up to 90 days). Anything that creates a recurring >$75k/yr obligation needs procurement+legal+finance sign-off. Tag me on PRDs for recurring infra spend.

taylor: Who negotiates vendor payment terms? Can teams ask for net-45/60?

maria: Procurement owns negotiations. Finance evaluates cash impact and approves net terms. For material vendors we'll try to secure milestone payments or net-60 when possible. Contact vendor-ops@redwood.com and cc finance-ops for requests.

sam: If a vendor only takes card but invoice would be preferred (audit reasons), any workaround?

maria: If vendor insists on card for >$5k, procurement can issue a virtual card after manager + finance approval, but we prefer invoice routing for amounts >$5k.

finance-bot: New ticket created: PROC-433 - Contractor renewal review (assigned to procurement).

hr_zoe: Any immediate changes to per-card or PO thresholds we should know about?

maria: No threshold changes today. Current quick reference: p-card single txn limit $2k, monthly card cap $5k default. Purchases >$5k -> PO + finance. We'll publish a short FAQ + flow chart by end of week.

vp_ops: Action items recap: 1) Publish "Hiring triggers & exceptions" doc by Thu. 2) Procurement to create a vendor-terms intake form by next Tue. 3) Finance to share updated runway scenarios (pessimistic/base/optimistic) with simple visuals by Fri.

taylor: Great, thanks. I'll forward this to Eng leads and Ops. :white_check_mark:
